QuestInfo.name: Mirror Worlds and Shadow Knights
QuestInfo.0: The Shadow Knight's duty begins anew. The mission will continue until the time comes to return to the real world. But who were you in that world? Who were you before you lost your memory? Will the outside world hold answers?
QuestInfo.2: Once you finished sorting the ingredients you gathered, you have a moment to admire his amazing fighting skill. But he's corrupted, and your mission is to deceive him...
